ns2:section.sectionText: 1 hours. Graduate Seminar in Ecology. Topic: Ecology of Infectious Diseases We will address the ecological factors that govern the transmission of vector-borne and zoonotic pathogens and parasites. Readings will be selected from current topics in disease ecology that highlight the: role of pathogens and parasites within food webs, effects of ecosystem change on infectious disease emergence, importance of mathematical ecology in predicting infectious disease dynamics, and future frontiers in disease ecology. Responsibility for leading discussion will rotate among the seminar participants and papers will be selected in consultation with the instructor. MEETS IN 515 MORRILL HALL.
